newsitem.title: USA: Heartland Wireless says three execs resign.
newsitem.headline: Heartland Wireless says three execs resign.

text.p: Heartland Wireless Communications Inc said Monday that John Bailey, Randy Hendrix and Robert Story have left the company as part of a management and operational restructuring.

The company said Bailey was formerly senior vice president, finance, chief financial officer, treasurer and assistant secretary; Hendrix was formerly senior vice president, marketing; and Story was formerly senior vice president, operations.

John A. Fanning, interim president and chief executive officer of Heartland, will assume the duties of Bailey until a replacement is named, it said. Other members of Heartland's management team will assume the duties of Hendrix and Story, it added.
It said it will release preliminary fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 1996 results on March 20.
